subject: POC alignment & access checklist — Zenova initial kickoff
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@zenova.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos@zenova.ai>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: today’s call — proposed POC scope and next steps

Asha — thanks for a productive discussion today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps to get the POC started. Please review and correct anything I missed.

Key pain you described
- Latency spikes on internal search & conversational assistants during peak business hours (up to 800ms tail tokens).
- Cost unpredictability: inconsistent per-token spend across models and tenant usage.
- Need for privacy controls / VPC egress limitations for regulated user subsets.

POC goals (success criteria)
1) Median response latency under 150ms for 90% of inference requests (3k token window).
2) 30% reduction in per-token cost vs current baseline for typical search traffic.
3) Integration with Zenova VPC + audit events visible in Console for the pilot dataset.

Proposed scope (what Redwood will deliver)
- Dedicated 2x A10 pools for Zenova pilot traffic, model: Llama-3 13B quantized variant.
- Prompt set + eval harness: 150 prompts (search, follow-up, rerank).
- Pre-configured batching and KV cache tuned to your sequence distribution.
- Weekly quality & cost report; alerting on regression.

Owners & timeline
- Zenova owner: Asha Rao (product).
- Redwood technical lead: Rishi Malhotra (inference).
- Kickoff / access window: target week of Jun 14 — 4 week pilot (data collection + 2 eval checkpoints).

Immediate asks for Zenova (action items)
1) Provide a small pilot dataset (500 representative queries + expected responses) — secure upload link below.
2) Open a temporary service account allowing inbound IPs 34.82.12.0/24 and 34.83.55.0/24.
3) Confirm compliance contact for SOC2 evidence (name + email).

Attachments: redwood-poc-scope-metrics-v1.xlsx (POC metrics + checkpoints), redwood-access-checklist.pdf (step-by-step access).

If this looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30m kickoff with Rishi + infra to walk access during the first day.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0148

From: Asha Rao <asha@zenova.ai>

Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: today’s call — proposed POC scope and next steps

Thanks Soojin — that captures the discussion well. A few clarifications from our side:

- We confirm the latency target is measured at the application edge (post-proxy). We’ll provide request/response traces for baseline.
- Instead of Llama-3 13B, our team prefers testing a 7B dense variant first to validate quality/cost tradeoffs; if the 7B meets quality bar we’ll scale to 13B.
- Compliance contact: Carlos Mendes (carlos@zenova.ai).

Actioning:
1) I’ll share a zipped sample of 520 queries by EOD Thu (Jun 11).
2) IT will open the firewall range you listed and we’ll confirm once complete.
3) We can do kickoff on Jun 15 at 10:00am PT — works for Rishi?

Quick question: for the service account do you support temporary key rotation or short-lived tokens for the pilot? We prefer not to give long-lived credentials.

—Asha
Asha Rao
Head of Product, Zenova.ai
asha@zenova.ai | +1 617-555-2120

Team — copying the external thread and pulling out internal action items ahead of the kickoff. Please confirm ownership & ETA in thread.

Action list (internal)
- Rishi: confirm model variants available on Dedicated pools (7B dense + 13B quantized) and pre-load weights — ETA Jun 14 EOD.
- Vanessa: prepare onboarding doc and short runbook for VPC peering & firewall setup; include steps for short-lived token issuance — ETA Jun 13.
- Priyom: create the eval harness repo with initial 150 prompts (use sample schema in redwood-poc-scope-metrics-v1.xlsx) and pre-populate with 20 gold examples — ETA Jun 14.

Notes: Asha prefers short-lived tokens. Vanessa, can we support token rotation via the Console with 24h TTL for the pilot? If not, document alternatives.

I’ll draft the kickoff invite for Jun 15 10:00am PT and include a 20m tech review + 10m access test.

Thanks — Soojin
